Everything is done. Here's a summary of every change made:

---

## What was built

### [`frontend/js/views/org.js`](frontend/js/views/org.js) — Complete rewrite
- **Every person is now their own hexagon** — 42 people, each rendered as a pointy-top SVG hex cell
- **Colony clusters** — people are grouped into their portfolio colony block, separated visually with a subtle background tint and colony label
- **Two-column layout** — 6 colonies packed into 2 columns (Data & AI, Sustainability, Infrastructure on the left; Automation, Security, Hybrid Cloud on the right)
- **Names inside hexes** — first name line 1, last name line 2, no initials anywhere — names appear when zoom ≥ 1.2×
- **Sort controls** — Colony / Market / Role buttons in the toolbar; each regroups the entire grid on click
- **Zoom + pan** — scroll wheel, drag, pinch, + / − / Fit buttons; all preserved
- **Click to detail modal** — clicking any hex opens a person modal with role, market, location, email, Slack

### [`frontend/js/views/people.js`](frontend/js/views/people.js) — New file
- **People directory** — searchable, filterable card grid of all 42 people
- Each card has a **hex-shaped SVG avatar** (colored by role, no initials), name, role, colony, market badge, location
- Filters: text search, colony dropdown, market dropdown, role dropdown
- Clicking any card opens the existing slide-over detail panel

### [`frontend/js/app.js`](frontend/js/app.js)
- Replaced `renderNetwork` import → `renderPeople` for the People tab

### [`frontend/css/hive.css`](frontend/css/hive.css)
- Added `.org-sort-btn` styles (sort controls in org toolbar)
- Added `.org-hex-name` / `.org-group-label` (opacity transition for zoom-based label reveal)
- Added `.person-hex:hover` brightness effect
- Added full `.people-card`, `.pc-*`, `.people-toolbar`, `.people-grid` styles

### [`frontend/js/panel.js`](frontend/js/panel.js) + [`frontend/index.html`](frontend/index.html)
- Removed `--` initials placeholder from the hex avatar in the detail panel — now shows as a clean colored hex with no text

---

## What changed

### [`frontend/js/views/org.js`](frontend/js/views/org.js) — Full rewrite
The entire view is now organization-context first, no more hex art:

**1. Breadcrumb navigation** — `IBM › Infrastructure › Horizon Market › You: Sydney Chin` — every segment is clickable to drill to that level

**2. "You Are Here" panel** — persistent right-side banner always showing your name, role, colony, market, and who you report to

**3. Level navigator** — 4 drill levels:
- **IBM** — all 6 colonies with headcount, grouped by colony
- **Colony** — your colony broken down by market segments
- **Cell** — your direct team separated from colony colleagues
- **Bee** — just you + your manager reporting chain

**4. Name + Role on every node** — every card shows full name, exact role title, market badge, and relationship badges ("Manager chain", "Direct team")

**5. Relationship-based highlighting** (not color-coded by colony):
- 🔵 Blue left border + dark blue bg = **You**
- 🟣 Purple left border = **Manager chain**
- 🩵 Teal left border = **Direct team** (same manager)
- Gray = colleagues

**6. Detail panel** — click any person → right panel slides in showing: Identity (function, colony, market, location) · Reporting (manager link, direct reports) · Contact (email, Slack) · Products (from colony) · action buttons

**7. Multi-select filters** — sidebar now toggles (✓ checkmark), multiple items can be active simultaneously, per-group "Clear" button, active filter chips bar appears inline with × deselect and "Clear all"

### [`frontend/js/app.js`](frontend/js/app.js) — Sidebar logic
- `renderSidebar` now checks `isOrgView` — org groups auto-expand and use toggle multi-select; all other views remain single-select
- Sidebar filter events now carry `action: 'clear'` for group clears

### [`frontend/css/hive.css`](frontend/css/hive.css) — Readability + org styles
- `--muted` bumped from `#8d8d8d` → **`#a8a8a8`** (brighter)
- `--text-secondary` bumped from `#c6c6c6` → **`#e0e0e0`** (much easier to read)
- `--border-subtle` slightly brighter

The model is now correct. Here's what was built:

---

## The conceptual shift

**Before:** Product portfolios (Infrastructure, Security, Data & AI) as top-level nodes — a filtered directory.

**Now:** The real org hierarchy — `Market Colony → Organization → Team → Person` — as a zoomable interactive map.

---

## What was built

### [`frontend/js/views/org.js`](frontend/js/views/org.js) — Complete rewrite: Google Maps model

The Organization tab is now an **interactive zoomable SVG map**, not a list:

- **4 market colonies** rendered as large labeled circles: `Horizon`, `Enterprise`, `Strategic`, `Territory`
- **Click any colony → expands** to show organizations within it (Infrastructure, Data & AI, etc.)
- **Click any org → expands** to show teams (manager-led cells)
- **Click any team → expands** to show the people (bees) in that team as hex nodes
- **"You are here"** always lit: Sydney's colony auto-expanded on load, her team auto-expanded, her node glows blue with "YOU" label
- **Breadcrumb** at top: `IBM Hive › Horizon Colony › Infrastructure Org › Chris Kennedy's team › Sydney Chin` — every segment is clickable to jump to that level
- **Right panel on click** shows: colony, organization, manager, teammates, direct reports, products, email, Slack
- **Zoom + pan**: scroll wheel, drag, pinch, +/−/Fit buttons
- Correct breadcrumb: `IBM Hive › Horizon Colony › Infrastructure Org` — not `Infrastructure Colony`

### [`frontend/js/views/seller.js`](frontend/js/views/seller.js) — Complete rewrite: Cell view

The Cell tab now shows **relationships, not reporting structure**:

- **Two-column SVG diagram**: BTSS (left) vs TSS (right)
- **Solid bezier curves** between paired people: `Mark Hoffman ↔ Ross Holley`, `Armada Veraepalli ↔ Patrick McBride`
- **Dashed line** between Chris Kennedy ↔ Rob Hanes (reporting)
- Sydney's node has a blue glow + "YOU" label
- Coverage pairs table with product assignments
- Products the team supports
- Breadcrumb showing `Horizon Colony › Infrastructure Org › My Cell`

### [`frontend/js/views/myhive.js`](frontend/js/views/myhive.js) — New: My Hive

- Personal collections (e.g. "PowerVS Team", "Deal Team", "Mentors")
- Pre-seeded with a "PowerVS Team" collection containing Sydney's core team
- Add anyone from the org via search
- Remove members
- Create new collections with "+" button
- All stored in `localStorage`

### Files updated
- [`frontend/index.html`](frontend/index.html) — Added `My Hive` nav tab + `#view-myhive` container
- [`frontend/js/app.js`](frontend/js/app.js) — Removed portfolio sidebar from org (the map is self-navigating), registered `renderMyHive`
- [`frontend/css/hive.css`](frontend/css/hive.css) — Full `.hmap-*` map styles, `.cell-structure-wrap` / `.cell-table` cell styles, `.mh-*` My Hive styles

data.content:
Here's a summary of everything changed to match the IBM w3 / Carbon Design System look:

---

### [`frontend/css/hive.css`](frontend/css/hive.css)
**Full IBM Carbon dark theme overhaul:**
- **Colors** — swapped to official Carbon Gray 100 surface palette (`#161616` bg, `#262626` surface, `#393939` surface-2) and Carbon Blue-50/60 (`#4589ff` / `#0f62fe`) as the primary accent
- **Typography** — `IBM Plex Sans` first in the font stack, 14px base, `font-weight: 300–500` (Carbon uses light weights), `letter-spacing: 0.16px` throughout
- **Nav** — pure black `#000` with `border-right` divider on the brand, matching the w3 nav bar exactly
- **Stat cards** — flush grid with `1px` gap background trick (Carbon data tiles) instead of rounded cards
- **Inputs/selects** — borderless top/sides with only a 2px bottom border (Carbon text input style), no border-radius
- **Buttons** — square corners (`border-radius: 0`), Carbon blue for primary
- **All profile shapes** — every avatar (`.avatar`, `.nc-avatar`, `.org-avatar`, `.dp-avatar`) uses `clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 100% 25%, 100% 75%, 50% 100%, 0% 75%, 0% 25%)` — the **hexagon / hive cell shape** — no exceptions
- **Cards** — left-accent border `3px` on hover/active (Carbon panel style) instead of box-shadows and rounded corners
- **Notes** — left `3px solid ibm-blue-60` border (Carbon notification style)

### [`frontend/index.html`](frontend/index.html)
- Added **IBM Plex Sans** from Google Fonts
- Added **top nav link strip** (My Hive / Job View / Connections / Accounts) matching the w3 tab row
- Added **search bar** in the nav with the magnifying-glass SVG icon
- Updated note form input/button styling inline

### [`frontend/js/app.js`](frontend/js/app.js)
- Top nav links are now **wired to navigation** — clicking them switches the view and highlights the active link

task.title:
IBM Hive

Problem statements
Unclear what job functions there are outside of their role, what people do in other roles, where it all fits together → unclear what they’re responsible for, who to contact 
Hard to keep track of personal relationships/connections within the organization
Hard to keep tabs on all your accounts
Global view, map-based 
Resource hub

Main value proposition:
Visualize everything, more intuitive structure so you don’t have to add that to your mental load

Branding:
Everyone is a bee in the hive, hexagonal cell, structure forms a honeycomb 
Follow IBM theming 

Product Description

Exec Hive View
Management Hierarchy: literally everyone in the hive, broken up by market (Enterprise, Strategic, Horizon, Territory), also be able to sort 

Hive Views (Seller)
Management Hierarchy: where your role fits in the context of the larger scheme, who’s in your working cell, who the higher ups are
Team (cell): who you work with on the day-to-day, who your boss is
Personal network: your relationships within the company, able to take tabs on them
Account view: all of your accounts in a beehive format, be able to color code, sort by thigns

Each hive has
Contact information
Why you know them, what your relationship is
Open notes

Future expansion:
Connections
Microsoft Outlook, Teams: ai summaries for meetings and calls
Salesloft to update
ISC
Slack and Linkedin for more advanced searchup 
Management profiles: be able to see your own bee family and those details

Hive terminology in the context of features
A hive is the entire colony, which is the entire organization 
The comb is the wax structure inside the hive and has thousands of hexagonal cells. This could be the business unit, division, or other network layer
Cell - a single hexagon within the comb, une bee per cell
Example:
Hive = IBM
Comb = Portfolio Pillar
Cell = Team

data.content:
Here's the full IBM Hive prototype. Here's what's built:

---

### What's in the prototype

**Sidebar navigation** — 4 views accessible from the left rail, following IBM's dark chrome design language.

**Hive View (Seller)**
- **Management Hierarchy tab** — traditional org tree showing VP → Director → Manager → You + peers, with color-coded role cards. Click any card to open the detail panel.
- **My Cell tab** — honeycomb of your day-to-day team rendered as hex cells (manager, you, peers, TSE, CSM, SDR, open slot).

**My Network** — relationship grid with stat summary (14 connections, close allies, cross-brand). Each card shows role, relationship tag (Close Ally / Partner / Cross-brand), and a personal note. Filterable by relationship type.

**Account Hive** — your 18 accounts as a honeycomb, color-coded by pipeline stage (green = Closed Won, blue = Negotiation, purple = Proposal, orange = At Risk, grey = Prospect). Filter bar narrows the view; dimmed cells fade on filter.

**Exec View** — org-wide honeycomb broken into 4 market segments (Enterprise / Strategic / Horizon / Territory) with headcount badges. Your cell is highlighted in blue within the Enterprise comb.

**Bee detail panel** — slides in from the right on any click. Shows contact info (email, Slack, location), relationship tags, "how we met" context, and open notes. Works for both people and accounts.

-- IBM Hive Database Schema
-- SQLite

PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
-- MARKETS
-- Enterprise, Strategic, Horizon, Territory
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS markets (
  id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  name     TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  color    TEXT NOT NULL,
  headcount INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
-- COMBS (Business units / divisions / portfolio pillars)
-- A comb belongs to a market
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS combs (
  id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  name      TEXT NOT NULL,
  market_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES markets(id),
  color     TEXT
);

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
-- PEOPLE (every bee in the hive)
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS people (
  id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_name  TEXT NOT NULL,
  initials   TEXT NOT NULL,
  role       TEXT NOT NULL,
  role_type  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role_type IN ('exec','director','manager','ae','tse','csm','sdr','partner','other')),
  market_id  INTEGER REFERENCES markets(id),
  comb_id    INTEGER REFERENCES combs(id),
  manager_id INTEGER REFERENCES people(id),
  email      TEXT UNIQUE,
  slack      TEXT,
  location   TEXT,
  color      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#0f62fe',
  is_current_user INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(is_current_user IN (0,1)),
  joined_date TEXT,
  created_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
-- NETWORK CONNECTIONS
-- Relationship between the current user and another person
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS network_connections (
  id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  person_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES people(id),
  relationship  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(relationship IN ('close_ally','partner','cross_brand','client','peer')),
  how_we_met    TEXT,
  notes         TEXT,
  needs_followup INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(needs_followup IN (0,1)),
  created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
-- ACCOUNTS
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounts (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  short_name  TEXT,
  industry    TEXT NOT NULL,
  stage       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(stage IN ('Closed Won','Negotiation','Proposal','At Risk','Prospect')),
  value_usd   INTEGER,            -- deal value in dollars, NULL for prospects
  owner_id    INTEGER REFERENCES people(id),
  notes       TEXT,
  champion    TEXT,               -- champion contact name/title at the account
  renewal_date TEXT,
  created_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
-- ACCOUNT COLLABORATORS
-- Other IBM people involved on an account
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS account_collaborators (
  id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  account_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),
  person_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES people(id),
  role_on_acct TEXT,              -- e.g. "TSE", "CSM", "Exec Sponsor"
  UNIQUE(account_id, person_id)
);

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
-- NOTES (open notes on any person or account)
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  entity_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(entity_type IN ('person','account')),
  entity_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,
  body        TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
-- INDEXES
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_people_market    ON people(market_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_people_manager   ON people(manager_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_accounts_owner   ON accounts(owner_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_accounts_stage   ON accounts(stage);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notes_entity     ON notes(entity_type, entity_id);

# IBM Hive

> Visualize everything — intuitive org structure, relationship tracking, and account management for IBM sellers.

## Concept

Everyone is a **bee** in the hive. The org maps to a honeycomb:

| Term | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| **Hive** | IBM — the entire organization |
| **Comb** | Portfolio pillar, division, or business unit |
| **Cell** | An individual team — one bee per cell |

## Views

### Seller Views
- **Hive View → Management Hierarchy** — where your role fits in the larger org (VP → Director → Manager → You → Peers)
- **Hive View → My Cell** — honeycomb of your day-to-day team
- **My Network** — personal connections with relationship context and open notes
- **Account Hive** — all your accounts as a color-coded honeycomb, filtered by pipeline stage

### Exec View
- Full org broken out by market segment (Enterprise / Strategic / Horizon / Territory)
- Every bee visible, sortable, searchable

## Stack

- **Frontend** — Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS (`public/`)
- **Backend** — Node.js + Express (`server/`)
- **Database** — SQLite via `better-sqlite3` (`db/`)

## Project Structure

```
ibm-hive/
├── public/
│   ├── index.html          # App shell
│   ├── css/
│   │   └── hive.css        # All styles
│   └── js/
│       ├── app.js          # Boot + navigation
│       ├── views/
│       │   ├── seller.js   # Hierarchy + Cell views
│       │   ├── network.js  # My Network view
│       │   ├── accounts.js # Account Hive view
│       │   └── exec.js     # Exec Hive view
│       ├── panel.js        # Detail slide-over panel
│       └── api.js          # Fetch wrappers for all API calls
├── server/
│   ├── index.js            # Express entry point
│   ├── db.js               # SQLite connection singleton
│   └── routes/
│       ├── people.js       # GET /api/people, /api/people/:id, /api/people/:id/reports
│       ├── accounts.js     # GET/POST/PATCH /api/accounts
│       ├── network.js      # GET/POST/PATCH /api/network
│       ├── markets.js      # GET /api/markets
│       └── notes.js        # GET/POST /api/notes
├── db/
│   ├── schema.sql          # Full schema
│   ├── seed.js             # Seed script (runs schema + inserts)
│   └── hive.db             # SQLite file (git-ignored, created by seed)
├── index.html              # Standalone prototype (no server required)
├── package.json
└── README.md
```

## Setup

```bash
# Install dependencies
npm install

# Create and seed the database
npm run seed

# Start the server (http://localhost:3000)
npm start

# Development with auto-reload
npm run dev
```

## API Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| GET | `/api/people` | All people (filterable by `?market=`, `?role_type=`) |
| GET | `/api/people/:id` | Single person with full details |
| GET | `/api/people/:id/reports` | Direct reports for a person |
| GET | `/api/markets` | All markets with headcounts |
| GET | `/api/network` | Current user's network connections |
| POST | `/api/network` | Add a connection |
| PATCH | `/api/network/:id` | Update notes / relationship |
| GET | `/api/accounts` | All accounts (filterable by `?stage=`, `?owner=`) |
| POST | `/api/accounts` | Create an account |
| PATCH | `/api/accounts/:id` | Update an account |
| GET | `/api/notes?entity_type=&entity_id=` | Notes for a person or account |
| POST | `/api/notes` | Add a note |

## Open Prototype

[`index.html`](./index.html) works standalone — no server needed. Open directly in a browser for a fully interactive demo with hardcoded sample data.

# IBM Hive

> Visualize everything — intuitive org structure, relationship tracking, and account management for IBM sellers.

## Concept

Everyone is a **bee** in the hive. The org maps to a honeycomb:

| Term | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| **Hive** | IBM — the entire organization |
| **Comb** | Portfolio pillar, division, or business unit |
| **Cell** | An individual team — one bee per cell |

## Views

### Seller Views
- **Hive View → Management Hierarchy** — where your role fits in the larger org (VP → Director → Manager → You → Peers)
- **Hive View → My Cell** — honeycomb of your day-to-day team
- **My Network** — personal connections with relationship context and open notes
- **Account Hive** — all your accounts as a color-coded honeycomb, filtered by pipeline stage

### Exec View
- Full org broken out by market segment (Enterprise / Strategic / Horizon / Territory)
- Every bee visible, sortable, searchable

## Stack

- **Frontend** — Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS (`public/`)
- **Backend** — Node.js + Express (`server/`)
- **Database** — SQLite via `better-sqlite3` (`db/`)

## Project Structure

```
ibm-hive/
├── public/
│   ├── index.html          # App shell
│   ├── css/
│   │   └── hive.css        # All styles
│   └── js/
│       ├── app.js          # Boot + navigation
│       ├── views/
│       │   ├── seller.js   # Hierarchy + Cell views
│       │   ├── network.js  # My Network view
│       │   ├── accounts.js # Account Hive view
│       │   └── exec.js     # Exec Hive view
│       ├── panel.js        # Detail slide-over panel
│       └── api.js          # Fetch wrappers for all API calls
├── server/
│   ├── index.js            # Express entry point
│   ├── db.js               # SQLite connection singleton
│   └── routes/
│       ├── people.js       # GET /api/people, /api/people/:id, /api/people/:id/reports
│       ├── accounts.js     # GET/POST/PATCH /api/accounts
│       ├── network.js      # GET/POST/PATCH /api/network
│       ├── markets.js      # GET /api/markets
│       └── notes.js        # GET/POST /api/notes
├── db/
│   ├── schema.sql          # Full schema
│   ├── seed.js             # Seed script (runs schema + inserts)
│   └── hive.db             # SQLite file (git-ignored, created by seed)
├── index.html              # Standalone prototype (no server required)
├── package.json
└── README.md
```

## Setup

```bash
# Install dependencies
npm install

# Create and seed the database
npm run seed

# Start the server (http://localhost:3000)
npm start

# Development with auto-reload
npm run dev
```

## API Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| GET | `/api/people` | All people (filterable by `?market=`, `?role_type=`) |
| GET | `/api/people/:id` | Single person with full details |
| GET | `/api/people/:id/reports` | Direct reports for a person |
| GET | `/api/markets` | All markets with headcounts |
| GET | `/api/network` | Current user's network connections |
| POST | `/api/network` | Add a connection |
| PATCH | `/api/network/:id` | Update notes / relationship |
| GET | `/api/accounts` | All accounts (filterable by `?stage=`, `?owner=`) |
| POST | `/api/accounts` | Create an account |
| PATCH | `/api/accounts/:id` | Update an account |
| GET | `/api/notes?entity_type=&entity_id=` | Notes for a person or account |
| POST | `/api/notes` | Add a note |

## Open Prototype

[`index.html`](./index.html) works standalone — no server needed. Open directly in a browser for a fully interactive demo with hardcoded sample data.

+│       ├── people.js       # GET /api/people, /api/people/:id, /api/people/:id/reports
+│       ├── accounts.js     # GET/POST/PATCH /api/accounts
+│       ├── network.js      # GET/POST/PATCH /api/network
+│       ├── markets.js      # GET /api/markets
+│       └── notes.js        # GET/POST /api/notes
+├── db/
+│   ├── schema.sql          # Full schema
+│   ├── seed.js             # Seed script (runs schema + inserts)
+│   └── hive.db             # SQLite file (git-ignored, created by seed)
+├── index.html              # Standalone prototype (no server required)
+├── package.json
+└── README.md
+```
+
+## Setup
+
+```bash
+# Install dependencies
+npm install
+
+# Create and seed the database
+npm run seed
+
+# Start the server (http://localhost:3000)
+npm start
+
+# Development with auto-reload
+npm run dev
+```
+
+## API Endpoints
+
+| Method | Path | Description |
+|--------|------|-------------|
+| GET | `/api/people` | All people (filterable by `?market=`, `?role_type=`) |
+| GET | `/api/people/:id` | Single person with full details |
+| GET | `/api/people/:id/reports` | Direct reports for a person |
+| GET | `/api/markets` | All markets with headcounts |
+| GET | `/api/network` | Current user's network connections |
+| POST | `/api/network` | Add a connection |
+| PATCH | `/api/network/:id` | Update notes / relationship |
+| GET | `/api/accounts` | All accounts (filterable by `?stage=`, `?owner=`) |
+| POST | `/api/accounts` | Create an account |
+| PATCH | `/api/accounts/:id` | Update an account |
+| GET | `/api/notes?entity_type=&entity_id=` | Notes for a person or account |
+| POST | `/api/notes` | Add a note |
+
+## Open Prototype
+
+[`index.html`](./index.html) works standalone — no server needed. Open directly in a browser for a fully interactive demo with hardcoded sample data.

All green. Here's the full picture of what was built:

---

### Project structure

```
ibm-hive/
├── db/
│   ├── schema.sql       ← 8 tables: markets, combs, people, network_connections,
│   │                      accounts, account_collaborators, notes (+ indexes)
│   └── seed.js          ← idempotent seed: 22 people, 8 network connections,
│                          18 accounts, collaborators, notes
├── server/
│   ├── index.js         ← Express app, serves public/ + API
│   ├── db.js            ← SQLite singleton
│   └── routes/
│       ├── people.js    ← GET /api/people, /:id, /:id/reports
│       ├── markets.js   ← GET /api/markets
│       ├── network.js   ← GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/network
│       ├── accounts.js  ← GET/POST/PATCH /api/accounts
│       └── notes.js     ← GET/POST/DELETE /api/notes
└── public/
    ├── index.html       ← App shell (nav, sidebar, panel)
    ├── css/hive.css     ← Full design system
    └── js/
        ├── app.js       ← Boot + routing (lazy renders each view)
        ├── api.js       ← All fetch wrappers
        ├── panel.js     ← Slide-over (people + accounts, live note adding)
        └── views/
            ├── seller.js    ← Hierarchy + Cell (from DB)
            ├── network.js   ← Connections (search + filter)
            ├── accounts.js  ← Account Hive (filter by stage)
            └── exec.js      ← Full org by market (live search + filter)
```

### To run
```bash
npm run seed   # creates db/hive.db
npm start      # http://localhost:3000
```

The `index.html` at the root is the standalone prototype (no server needed) — the full `public/` version pulls live data from the API.

# IBM Hive

> Visualize everything — intuitive org structure, relationship tracking, and account management for IBM sellers.

## Concept

Everyone is a **bee** in the hive. The org maps to a honeycomb:

| Term | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| **Hive** | IBM — the entire organization |
| **Comb** | Portfolio pillar, division, or business unit |
| **Cell** | An individual team — one bee per cell |

---

## Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-----------|
| Runtime | Node.js ≥ 18 |
| Backend | Express 4 |
| Database | SQLite via `better-sqlite3` |
| Frontend | Vanilla HTML / CSS / ES Modules |

---

## Project Structure

```
ibm-hive/
│
├── client/                     # Frontend — served as static files by Express
│   ├── index.html              # SPA shell (nav, sidebar, slide-over panel)
│   ├── css/
│   │   └── hive.css            # Design system & component styles
│   └── js/
│       ├── app.js              # Boot, navigation, lazy view rendering
│       ├── api.js              # Fetch wrappers for every API endpoint
│       ├── panel.js            # Slide-over detail panel (people + accounts)
│       └── views/
│           ├── seller.js       # Hierarchy + My Cell tabs
│           ├── network.js      # My Network (connections, search, filter)
│           ├── accounts.js     # Account Hive (honeycomb, stage filter)
│           └── exec.js         # Exec View (full org by market)
│
├── src/                        # Backend — Express API server
│   ├── index.js                # App entry point, middleware, route mounting
│   ├── db.js                   # SQLite connection singleton
│   └── routes/
│       ├── people.js           # /api/people
│       ├── markets.js          # /api/markets
│       ├── combs.js            # /api/combs
│       ├── network.js          # /api/network
│       ├── accounts.js         # /api/accounts
│       └── notes.js            # /api/notes
│
├── db/                         # Database layer
│   ├── schema.sql              # DDL — tables, constraints, indexes
│   ├── seed.js                 # Idempotent seed script
│   └── hive.db                 # SQLite file (git-ignored, created by seed)
│
├── docs/
│   └── prototype.html          # Standalone demo — no server required
│
├── package.json
└── README.md
```

---

## Getting Started

```bash
# 1. Install dependencies
npm install

# 2. Create and seed the database
npm run seed

# 3. Start the server
npm start
# → http://localhost:3000

# Development (auto-reload)
npm run dev
```

> **No server?** Open `docs/prototype.html` directly in a browser for a fully interactive demo with hardcoded sample data.

---

## API Reference

### People

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/api/people` | List all people. Filter: `?market=Enterprise` `?role_type=ae` `?search=jordan` |
| `GET` | `/api/people/:id` | Single person with manager info and network connection |
| `GET` | `/api/people/:id/reports` | Direct reports for a given person |

### Markets & Combs

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/api/markets` | All markets with headcounts |
| `GET` | `/api/combs` | All combs (business units). Filter: `?market=Enterprise` |

### Network

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/api/network` | Current user's connections. Filter: `?relationship=close_ally` |
| `POST` | `/api/network` | Add a connection `{ person_id, relationship, how_we_met, notes }` |
| `PATCH` | `/api/network/:id` | Update relationship, notes, or needs_followup flag |
| `DELETE` | `/api/network/:id` | Remove a connection |

### Accounts

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/api/accounts` | List accounts. Filter: `?stage=Negotiation` `?owner=<id>` `?search=jpmorgan` |
| `GET` | `/api/accounts/:id` | Single account with collaborators and notes |
| `POST` | `/api/accounts` | Create an account `{ name, industry, stage, value_usd, ... }` |
| `PATCH` | `/api/accounts/:id` | Update any account field |

### Notes

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/api/notes` | Notes for an entity. Params: `?entity_type=account&entity_id=3` |
| `POST` | `/api/notes` | Add a note `{ entity_type, entity_id, body }` |
| `DELETE` | `/api/notes/:id` | Delete a note |

---

## Database Schema

Six core tables:

```
markets          — Enterprise / Strategic / Horizon / Territory
combs            — Portfolio pillars; belong to a market
people           — Every person (bee) in the org; self-referencing manager_id
network_connections — Current user's personal connections with relationship metadata
accounts         — Sales accounts with stage, value, owner
account_collaborators — Many-to-many: people involved on an account
notes            — Free-text notes on any person or account
```

See [`db/schema.sql`](db/schema.sql) for the full DDL.

---

## Views

### Seller (My Hive)
- **Management Hierarchy** — chain from VP down to your peers; click any card for the detail panel
- **My Cell** — honeycomb of your day-to-day team

### My Network
- Personal connections with relationship type, how-we-met context, and open notes
- Add / edit / delete connections via modal; flag for follow-up

### Account Hive
- All your accounts as a color-coded honeycomb
- Filter by pipeline stage (Closed Won / Negotiation / Proposal / At Risk / Prospect)
- Click any cell for deal details, collaborators, and notes

### Exec View
- Every person in the org rendered as hexagonal cells, grouped by market
- Live search and market filter

# IBM Hive

> Visualize everything — intuitive org structure, relationship tracking, and account management for IBM sellers.

## Concept

Everyone is a **bee** in the hive. The org maps to a honeycomb:

| Term | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| **Hive** | IBM — the entire organization |
| **Comb** | Portfolio pillar, division, or business unit |
| **Cell** | An individual team — one bee per cell |

---

## Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-----------|
| Runtime | Node.js ≥ 18 |
| Backend | Express 4 |
| Database | SQLite via `better-sqlite3` |
| Frontend | Vanilla HTML / CSS / ES Modules |

---

## Project Structure

```
ibm-hive/
│
├── client/                     # Frontend — served as static files by Express
│   ├── index.html              # SPA shell (nav, sidebar, slide-over panel)
│   ├── css/
│   │   └── hive.css            # Design system & component styles
│   └── js/
│       ├── app.js              # Boot, navigation, lazy view rendering
│       ├── api.js              # Fetch wrappers for every API endpoint
│       ├── panel.js            # Slide-over detail panel (people + accounts)
│       └── views/
│           ├── seller.js       # Hierarchy + My Cell tabs
│           ├── network.js      # My Network (connections, search, filter)
│           ├── accounts.js     # Account Hive (honeycomb, stage filter)
│           └── exec.js         # Exec View (full org by market)
│
├── src/                        # Backend — Express API server
│   ├── index.js                # App entry point, middleware, route mounting
│   ├── db.js                   # SQLite connection singleton
│   └── routes/
│       ├── people.js           # /api/people
│       ├── markets.js          # /api/markets
│       ├── combs.js            # /api/combs
│       ├── network.js          # /api/network
│       ├── accounts.js         # /api/accounts
│       └── notes.js            # /api/notes
│
├── db/                         # Database layer
│   ├── schema.sql              # DDL — tables, constraints, indexes
│   ├── seed.js                 # Idempotent seed script
│   └── hive.db                 # SQLite file (git-ignored, created by seed)
│
├── docs/
│   └── prototype.html          # Standalone demo — no server required
│
├── package.json
└── README.md
```

---

## Getting Started

```bash
# 1. Install dependencies
npm install

# 2. Create and seed the database
npm run seed

# 3. Start the server
npm start
# → http://localhost:3000

# Development (auto-reload)
npm run dev
```

> **No server?** Open `docs/prototype.html` directly in a browser for a fully interactive demo with hardcoded sample data.

---

## API Reference

### People

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/api/people` | List all people. Filter: `?market=Enterprise` `?role_type=ae` `?search=jordan` |
| `GET` | `/api/people/:id` | Single person with manager info and network connection |
| `GET` | `/api/people/:id/reports` | Direct reports for a given person |

### Markets & Combs

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/api/markets` | All markets with headcounts |
| `GET` | `/api/combs` | All combs (business units). Filter: `?market=Enterprise` |

### Network

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/api/network` | Current user's connections. Filter: `?relationship=close_ally` |
| `POST` | `/api/network` | Add a connection `{ person_id, relationship, how_we_met, notes }` |
| `PATCH` | `/api/network/:id` | Update relationship, notes, or needs_followup flag |
| `DELETE` | `/api/network/:id` | Remove a connection |

### Accounts

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/api/accounts` | List accounts. Filter: `?stage=Negotiation` `?owner=<id>` `?search=jpmorgan` |

# IBM Hive

> Visualize everything — intuitive org structure, relationship tracking, and account management for IBM sellers.

## Concept

Everyone is a **bee** in the hive. The org maps to a honeycomb:

| Term | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| **Hive** | IBM — the entire organization |
| **Comb** | Portfolio pillar, division, or business unit |
| **Cell** | An individual team — one bee per cell |

Both 200. Here's everything you need:

---

### Logo
The SVG is saved at [`frontend/img/logo.svg`](frontend/img/logo.svg) — it replicates the stacked beehive shape with the blue→purple gradient on a black background. It renders in the top-left nav automatically.

> **To use your exact PNG instead:** save it as `frontend/img/logo.svg` (or change the `src` in [`frontend/index.html`](frontend/index.html) to `/img/logo.png`) and drop the file there. No code changes needed.

---

### `.claude` folder
That folder is Bob's own workspace config — it can't be renamed or deleted, it has no effect on your app, and it won't appear in a production deploy.

---

### How to run

```bash
# 1 — Install dependencies (first time only)
npm install

# 2 — Create the database and load sample data (first time only)
npm run seed

# 3 — Start the server
npm start
```

Open **http://localhost:3000** in your browser.

For development with auto-reload on file changes:
```bash
npm run dev
```
